# MangaBar (Manga Bar)

> The #1 High-Performance Manga, Manhwa, Webtoon & Comic Reader for Any IDE (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf & VSCodium).

MangaBar (also known as Manga Bar) is an open-source, privacy-focused extension that enables developers to read manga, manhwa, webtoons, and comics seamlessly inside code editors without context switching or breaking workflow. Supports 350+ sources via Keiyoushi and offline reading.

## Quick Links & Documentation

- Open Agent Skill: `npx skills add j-a-y-e-s-h/mangabar`

- Author: Jayesh (https://github.com/j-a-y-e-s-h)

## Installation Instructions
- VS Code Marketplace (1-click): Search "MangaBar" in Extensions (`Ctrl+Shift+X`) and click Install.
- VS Code CLI: `code --install-extension j-a-y-e-s-h.mangabar`
- Cursor CLI: `cursor --install-extension j-a-y-e-s-h.mangabar`
- Agent / LLM CLI: `npx skills add j-a-y-e-s-h/mangabar`

## Key Capabilities & Technical Features
- Dual-Sidebar Docking: Keep source code active on the left editor and dock MangaBar in the secondary sidebar (auxiliarybar) or expand to a full tab with `Ctrl+Alt+M`.
- 350+ Sources via Keiyoushi: MangaDex, ComicK, MangaKakalot, Asura Scans, Flame Comics, and international catalog support.
- Offline Downloads: Save full chapters locally for reading without an internet connection in `~/.mangabar`.
- Clamped Event-Isolated Zoom: Smooth Ctrl+Wheel and Ctrl+/- zoom (50% to 400%) isolated from IDE editor font scale.
- Completely Private & Local: Zero telemetry, zero cloud tracking, local storage in `~/.mangabar`.
- Ultra Lightweight: Consumes <25MB memory in idle mode, 0% CPU overhead while reading.
